items.name: Dual FMC and More Maine 2026
items.information:
**This competition will not be holding 3x3 but will instead be featuring Fewest Moves (FMC),  3x3 Blindfolded, 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-Blind, and Big Cubes (5x5-7x7). While first time competitors are welcome to compete, you may want to check out other competitions with more commonly held events.**

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa3hrIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ae8bf56bdf7df2a9ddef232b67ef1762d8b05535/logo_200x200.png)

This competition is organized by Cube New England, a non-profit organization dedicated to the growth of speedcubing in New England.

* [Visit our **webpage**](https://www.cubenewengland.com)
* [See our **upcoming competitions**](https://www.cubenewengland.com/competitions)
* [Follow us on **Facebook**](https://facebook.com/cubenewengland)
* [Join our **Facebook community**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/402975042172435)
* [Join our Facebook community for **parents**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/732527678812618)
* [Join our **Discord**](https://discord.gg/3mX6xKUdRC)

Students & Staff of any MSAD54 school can compete in this competition free of charge. After you have registered for this competition (and prior to paying), please use your district-issued email address to email the organizer Tommy Chestnutt @ tchestnutt@msad54.org. After confirming your relationship with the district, your registration will be accepted. All other registration regulations remain the same (competiiton limits, registration timeline, etc.).

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTkzODAxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c77fda2d866bd52b21303dd5419966169f195772/Panama%20Nationals%20Logos.png)
**Español**
• Nacionales 2026 en la Ciudad de Panamá!
• 13 categorías, dos días de competencia y cuberos de todo el pais. No te lo pierdas!!
• Los resultados preliminares, y los clasificados a rondas posteriores, se podrán ver casi en tiempo real en Integrated Live Results (en la pestaña de resultados).

**English**
• National Championships 2026 in Panama City!
• 13 categories, two days of competition, and cubers from all over the country. Don't miss it!!
• Preliminary results, as well as the names of those who have qualified for subsequent rounds, can be viewed almost in real time via Integrated Live Results (under the results tab).
